newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong police arrest 33 in anti-triad operation.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong police arrest 33 in anti-triad operation.

text.p: Hong Kong police said on Friday they had arrested 33 suspected gangsters after a territory-wide sweep in which more than 30 places were raided.
The 25 men and eight women arrested were believed to be involved in extortion, trafficking in dangerous drugs, and managing a triad society, or secret organization, a police statement said.
A small quantity of cocaine and marijuana were seized during the operation, which was carried out after a six-month covert investigation into triad activities, police said.
Twenty-four of those arrested were still being detained for questioning and the others had been freed on bail.
Police said the investigation was still continuing.
